title: Commit options
description: Commit selected project files. Leave options unset to inherit project configuration and command defaults.

files.title: Selected files
files.description: Current project changes to commit. Paths are checked against the working tree before queuing.

message.title: Commit message
message.description: Optional conventional commit message. Leave blank for AI generation. Grouped commits receive individual generated messages.

commit-all.title: Split into logical commits
commit-all.description: Group only the selected files. Enabling grouping clears an explicit message; disabling it clears grouping overrides.

max-commits.title: Maximum logical commits
max-commits.description: Leave unset to inherit commit.maxCommits, otherwise seven. Excludes the generated-files commit. Setting this also enables grouping.

lint-secrets.title: Secret checks
lint-secrets.description: Choose Inherit to use commit.lint.secrets; enabled by default.

ai-fix.title: Repair lint findings
ai-fix.description: Choose Inherit to use commit.lint.aiFix. Disabling repair clears its iteration override.

ai-fix-max-iterations.title: Maximum repair iterations
ai-fix-max-iterations.description: Leave unset to inherit commit.lint.aiFixMaxIterations, otherwise three. An explicit limit must be positive.

tidy.title: Tidy Go modules
tidy.description: Choose Inherit to use commit.tidy.enabled. Can stage go.mod and go.sum updates.

model.title: Message model
model.description: Optional Captain selector, for example agent:sonnet. Inherits the configured commit message model.

effort.title: Reasoning effort
effort.description: Optional reasoning effort supported by the selected model.

precommit.title: Precommit checks
precommit.description: Fail on gitignore and linked-dependency findings, or explicitly skip these checks.

force.title: Skip commit hooks
force.description: Skip configured commit hooks. Lint and precommit options are controlled separately.

dry-run.title: Preview without committing
dry-run.description: Generate the proposed messages without creating commits. AI generation still runs.

add-metadata.title: Include session metadata
add-metadata.description: Append issue and session trailers when session metadata is available. Enabled by default.
